_note: Candidate official pages for scripts/verify_base_graph.py to fetch, keyed by base-graph node id. A URL here is something to check, not evidence: a node earns a source only when the verifier fetched the page and found the node's name on it as a label of its own (see evidence.json). A node without an entry is checked against its nearest ancestor's pages. Every URL must be https on a .gov or .mil host, which is what the evidence standard counts as official and what the verifier will agree to fetch — usps.com and si.edu are the real homes of USPS and the Smithsonian but are not .gov, so those two nodes have no candidate page rather than a page the verifier would refuse. Candidates seeded from the Federal Register agency directory by scripts/seed_official_sites.py are marked in data/verification/official_sites_provenance.json.
